hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: Manages NFT-backed strategy pools with gated initialization and liquidity (only callable via a factory), and applies time-decaying buy fees that start at 99% and decrease every 5 blocks. Fees are taken from swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributed to a vault, collection owner, and protocol address; if the fee is in a non-ETH token, it is first swapped back to ETH internally.
